name: Camping Seehof
beschreibung: The **Camping Seehof** campsite is located in the municipality of **Kramsach** in the Tiroler Unterinntal region, right by the **Brandenberger Ache** river. The area is shaped by the **Rofan and Brandenberger Alps**, offering a network of **hiking and cycling trails**, as well as nearby lakes for swimming. In winter, the **Alpbachtal Wildschönau ski area** is just a short drive away. The site is divided into plots and designed to be mostly quiet and **nature-focused**. Facilities include modern sanitary buildings, a kiosk, and a restaurant. In addition to pitches, **rental accommodations** in the form of mobile homes are available. Guests use the location as a **starting point** for adventures in the surrounding mountains and valleys. The **connection** to the regional transport network also allows trips into the **Inntal** region and beyond.
